ledger.x: 1222: Baraq Hajib founds the dynasty in Kerman.
ledger.cp: Shuja ad-Din Abul-Qasim, governor of Kerman (the page names no overlord)

ledger.x: 1306: the Ilkhanid ruler Öljaitü ends the dynasty: 'ended the Kirman Kara-Khitan dynasty in 1306'; 'The dynasty was removed from power by the Ilkhanid ruler Öljaitü'.
1306: Disestablished 1306; the last Qutlugh Khan, Qutb al-Din Shah Jahan, escaped to Shiraz.

wars.name: Baraq Hajib's conquest of Kerman
wars.outcome: Baraq Hajib defeated the governor 'thanks to defection of Turks', besieged Kirman and, with help from Jalal ad-Din, conquered it.

wars.name: Ilkhanid removal of the Qutlugh-Khanids
wars.outcome: Öljaitü ended the dynasty in 1306 and the last Qutlugh Khan escaped to Shiraz; the Ilkhanate took Kerman.

certainty.note: Only Kerman province is named; nothing opened gives frontiers, Makran, the Hormuz coast or Fars, and the pages do not say when the Mongol suzerainty began (Baraq Hajib 'later submitted to the Mongol Empire').
